symptom: XiaoYu proposed mini-games while the owner still had work to do, and later again while a game was active because N.E.K.O misclassified the activity as interruptible.

upstream_diagnosis.known_gap: N.E.K.O proactive-chat user-directives reference documents #3013: rest reminders, mini-game invitations and voice reminders do not pass the directive output gate.
upstream_diagnosis.ordinary_invite_before: Canned mini-game delivery blocked missing activity, restricted_screen_only, away and unfinished_thread, but otherwise a 10-second delivery idle window could admit transitioning/chatting/voice_engaged/stale_returning states.

work_break_before.meaning: A focused-work water/stretch break reminder had a 50% branch into a rest-plus-mini-game invitation.

post_first_fix_recurrence.observation: mini-game invite declined after leisure-only 0009 was live
post_first_fix_recurrence.root_cause: the mini-game gate trusted ActivitySnapshot state; the upstream activity classifier can miss an active game, so a false idle/casual state can still pass the allowlist

live_observation.interpretation: The missing ordinary 'Mini-game invite delivered' marker makes the work-break combo the strongest match, but the log does not prove the source path with certainty.

windows_interruptibility.integration: sampled inside the existing 5-second SystemSignalCollector executor hop; no new timer, thread, database, or model call
windows_interruptibility.decision_axis: does not rewrite ActivitySnapshot.state; when Windows says normal notification UI is inappropriate, only propensity is narrowed to closed
windows_interruptibility.remote_behavior: ignored when os_signals_available is false so a remote backend cannot veto based on the server desktop

regression.native_preference_helper: ensures only work_break_game_invite_probability=0.0 in the existing user_preferences.json activity section; verify-only is non-mutating

known_nonblocking_startup_signals: Steamworks API initialization failure continues as native nonblocking fallback
startup-only loop stalls around 1-2 seconds recovered automatically

external_validation.meaning: the external authority tracks current Windows receptivity rather than permanently classifying the user as busy
